original_title: Uganda suspends all cross-border traffic with DR Congo to curb Ebola

ai_analysis.immediate_forecast_24h: Within the next 48 hours, all cross-border traffic and flights between Uganda and DR Congo will be halted, potentially causing disruptions to transport and logistics.
ai_analysis.strategic_outlook: The long-term impact of this suspension will depend on the effectiveness of the measures in curbing the Ebola outbreak, but it may lead to increased security measures and potential border closures in the region.
